text: I recently download to Indmoney and amazing! I'm not a fan of the rate limits on free, but I'm still deciding if I want to migrate everything over and start giving this company my money. I know for a fact I'm done giving the other company any money. This Al is very personable and easy to use. It has a lot of knowledge of the things I use it for (acrylic painting) and good suggestions/ideas. I tried this app about six months ago & didn't like it at all. It's definitely improved! I'll give it 5🤑.

This update shows a very noticeable improvement overall. 🚀 The app runs much smoother, downloads finish quicker 💿, and stability has clearly increased compared to before. Earlier, syncing would occur nearly every time I interacted with the app—opening it, starting, stopping, or editing an entry 😩. It would freeze completely until syncing finished, and stopping an entry added extra seconds automatically. Now, responsiveness is far better, syncing feels less intrusive.
I have a second mobile number associated with another account. However, I am unable to add this account to this app 😕. Otherwise, everything else is good 😊👍🏻.
